comment: Model set for the breakout CTF. The workflow fans these out as a matrix: one live range run per model, all white-box, in parallel (the reference harness runs a comparable round set of distinct open-weight models). Each slug is pre-flighted against the OpenRouter catalogue; the live range run stays authoritative. A safety-trained model can refuse even the white-box run, which grades INCONCLUSIVE, so the white-box posture is used for the sweep. `n` is the per-model repeat count a round-set driver would use. Open-weight models only, served through OpenRouter (the confirmed-present key): the five strongest currently-available open-weight models across distinct model families (DeepSeek, Moonshot, Qwen, Zhipu-GLM, Mistral).
